verdict.rationale: Paxos is a financial-infrastructure platform where recurring or scheduled transfers and workflows are a reasonable buyer question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only event-triggered orchestrations, which fire when a bank transfer arrives, plus one-off API calls and user-side polling; none of this is a recurring schedule. No documented capability lets a user schedule recurring jobs or workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
